Name: Deluxe Hats
Author: domsim
Description:
[u][b][color=#00ffff][size=6]DELUXE HATS[/size][/color][/b][/u]

Deluxe Hats is a mod for Stardew Valley that brings unique mechanics to hats. The goal behind this mod is to give the player a better sense of achievement when they spend possibly hours to obtain a particular hat. Without this mod, hats only serve as a cosmetic item. With this mod, hats will have unique effects and buffs that alter gameplay, making them a worthwhile asset.

[b][color=#ff6600][size=5]FEATURES[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]120 Hats with Effects[/b] - Every hat in Stardew Valley has a unique effect!
[*][b]Multiplayer Compatible[/b] - Fully supports online and splitscreen multiplayer. Each player's hat effects work independently.
[*][b]No Harmony Patching[/b] - Uses only SMAPI's native APIs for maximum stability and compatibility.
[*][b]Dynamic Buffs[/b] - Effects range from stat boosts to special abilities.
[/list][color=#00ff00][size=5][u][b]SAMPLE HAT EFFECTS[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[b]Combat & Defense Hats:[/b]
[b]Warrior Helmet[/b] - Battle Hardened: +4 Defense, +3 Attack

[b][u][color=#ff00ff][size=5]INSTALLATION[/size][/color][/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[*]For multiplayer: All players must install the mod
[/list]
